title: Gazetteer Requests
description: The Claude -> Ingram 'please define this place' queue -- Stage 7 of the original Gazetteer plan. Raised when writing lore for one place turns up a second one that matters but has no shape or note yet, so it is not lost in conversation scrollback. Deliberately carries no proposed shape or lore of its own: per the standing rule against inventing what a place IS, a request says a gap exists, never what should fill it. Consumed by tools/gazetteer/core/requests.py.

what.description: What needs defining, in one line.

why.description: What this is blocked on, or where it came up -- so it can be judged without reconstructing the conversation that raised it.

hint.description: A grid reference (e.g. 'C4.11') pointing at roughly where this belongs, so opening the map means going straight there rather than searching. Null when nothing narrower than 'somewhere on the map' is known yet.

blocks.description: Scene brief ids (episode-c1e1--the-errand) whose placing is waiting on this request. While it is open, the journey corpus test (test/tier2-journey-corpus.test.mjs) lets those scenes have no place, and says what they are waiting for; once it is resolved they must have one. Added 2026-10-07.

resolution.description: One line on how it was resolved -- e.g. the localId or location id that now fills the gap.
